title: MongoDB Receipt Documents in C23
practicalRequirements: Start with the invented data and trace the steps on paper. Optional compiler, SDK and adapter steps are for your own practice environment. Optional BSON practice uses libbson, and an optional owner-prepared database uses the MongoDB C driver.

lessons.title: Read a receipt document and its required fields
Inspect a BSON field from the C driver boundary
Distinguish an empty cursor from a failed lookup
